title: Metric-Tensor Scaling in Liouville Quantum Gravity
exact_target: Does the Liouville quantum gravity metric have the proposed formal conformal scaling with its Hausdorff dimension?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003287 (OWR-15176-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Heat Kernels, Stochastic Processes and Functional Inequalities (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/55, pp. 3087--3147. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 31, 32, 33.
Miller and Sheffield QLE metric (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Gwynne, Miller, and Sheffield LQG metric (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The displayed tensor is expressly formal. Because $h$ is distribution-valued, this is not an equality of pointwise metric coefficients; a regularization and limiting distance construction are required. No particular formula for $\beta$ is added.
